effect.words: Which rows do your bees avoid?
effect.reply: The south rows, every one. Bees know a sick flower before the vine does. Three weeks they've flown round those rows like there's a ditch in the way.
Outward, is it? My sows went courting and the wild boar came back with them. I've mended it twice. Every boar in the Sunfields knows the way to our sties now.

effect.words: The vine hand knows a cure. Let's try it.
effect.reply: Oak bark and lime on a sick root, the Oakhaven way? It's a gamble, my apple. Ripe or rotten. Bring him three of bark and two of lime, and I'll hold the rows till he's done.

effect.text: SOUTHMEADOW VINEYARD: hands wanted for the picking. Every grape picked is one the Captain's companies don't eat. Sloe Harvestby.

phases.journal: Black leaves curl on the south rows of the Southmeadow vineyard, and wild boar root in them by night.

effects.text: Harvest to you. Mind where you tread in the south rows. The leaves are blighted and the ground's all boar-dug.
Down from the Southwood, along the stream, under the old fence. I was lost three days in that wood once. I know its paths better than I'd like. Good harvest if you find the gap.

phases.journal: The rows have been kept. Now Southmeadow must choose: burn the sick vines, or try the vine hand's old cure of bark and lime.

effects.text: Burn them, or try the vine hand's cure, my apple? I can't choose for the whole valley. Say which, and put your back into it.
Where I was raised they paint a sick root with oak bark and lime, and pray to the Bright One it takes. Three of bark and two of lime, and I'll do the painting.

phases.journal: The south rows of Southmeadow were burned for the blight. No wine from them this year, but the ground is clean.

effects.text: Ash where the south rows stood. No wine from them this year, but clean ground. Ripe days next year, Bright One willing.

effects.words: the south rows burned for the blight

effects.text: SOUTHMEADOW VINEYARD: the blighted south rows are burned. No wine from them this year, but the ground is clean. Our thanks to every wolf who carried firewood. Sloe Harvestby.

phases.journal: The vine hand's cure took. Southmeadow's south rows are green again.

effects.text: Ripe days, my apple, ripe days. Green leaves on every row, and a bark poultice on every root.
SOUTHMEADOW VINEYARD: the bark-and-ash cure has taken, and there are green leaves on every row. Our thanks to every wolf who carried bark and lime. Sloe Harvestby.

phases.journal: The cure did not take. The blight is past the Southmeadow rows this year.

effects.text: We tried the old cure and the blight walked past it. Blight take it. I'll not forget who carried the bark, mind.

effects.words: the blight past the Southmeadow rows

effects.text: SOUTHMEADOW VINEYARD: the cure did not take, and the south rows are lost this year. Our thanks all the same to every wolf who carried bark and lime. Sloe Harvestby.

quests.title: Black Leaves
quests.summary: Black leaves curl on the south vine rows at Southmeadow, and boar dig in them by night. Walk the rows, ask the beekeeper, and bring the vine-tender wood ash.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Not a good harvest, not this year. Black leaves on the south rows, curling like burnt paper, and boar in at night eating what's left. Blight take it. Walk the rows, ask the beekeeper which rows her bees won't touch, and bring me wood ash.
offer.handIn: The bees shun the south rows.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. The south rows, then, and spreading north. #oath#, I've coin put by for a row of my own, and it's dying before I can buy it. The boar first. Hunt them out of my rows.

objectives.label: Walk the south vine rows round the Southmeadow press.
Ask the beekeeper at the Sunfields Bee Garth which rows her bees avoid.
Bring the vine-tender two of wood ash for the roots.

rewards.detail: found the blight in the Southmeadow vines

quests.title: The Boar in the Rows
quests.summary: Hunt the boar out of the Southmeadow rows, and find where they get in.

objectives.label: Hunt boar in the vine country (two will do).
Ask the vine hand at the Press House where the boar come from.
Find the broken fence by the Southwood sties.
Tell the swineherd at Southwood her fence is broken outward.
Keep the vine rows one night: be among them in the small hours.

quests.title: Burn the Sick Rows
quests.summary: Burn the sick south rows before the blight spreads. No wine from them this year.

objectives.label: Bring the vine-tender four of firewood for the burning.
Be in the south rows at dusk, when the fires are lit.

rewards.detail: burned the blighted Southmeadow rows to save the next vintage

quests.title: Bark and Ash
quests.summary: Gather oak bark and lime for the vine hand's old Oakhaven cure. It may save the rows, or not.

objectives.label: Tell the vine-tender you'll try the vine hand's cure.

Give the vine hand three of oak bark.
Give the vine hand two of lime.
